Stake and vote account update logic for epoch activation and delegation refresh.

# Purpose
This C file implements stake epoch processing for the bank state. It updates stake delegation records, refreshes vote account stake values, and advances stake history at epoch boundaries. The main flow is in [`fd_stakes_activate_epoch`](<#fd_stakes_activate_epoch>), which reads the `StakeHistory` sysvar, computes the current epoch stake totals from `fd_stake_delegations_t`, writes the new history entry, increments the bank epoch, and then calls [`fd_refresh_vote_accounts`](<#fd_refresh_vote_accounts>) to recompute vote account stake for the new epoch. The helper [`fd_stake_weights_by_node`](<#fd_stake_weights_by_node>) builds a list of vote account weights from vote state records and sorts them by stake.

The file also contains account update helpers for stake and vote accounts. [`fd_stakes_update_stake_delegation`](<#fd_stakes_update_stake_delegation>) reads a stake account, checks whether it is valid and initialized, and then updates or removes the matching stake delegation entry in the bank delta set. [`fd_stakes_update_vote_state`](<#fd_stakes_update_vote_state>) performs the same kind of maintenance for vote accounts by removing empty or invalid accounts and updating the in-memory vote state from account data. [`write_stake_state`](<#write_stake_state>) encodes a `fd_stake_state_v2_t` value into a transaction account buffer. Together, these functions provide the stake and vote state maintenance logic used by the runtime during account changes and epoch transitions.
